within_island_selector: environment-free greedy maximum covered land-grid cells

allocation_rules.global_max_coverage: no island quota; strong geometry-only control
allocation_rules.land_area: slots proportional to public land-grid cell counts
allocation_rules.training_occurrence: slots proportional to thinned training occurrence counts with Dirichlet pseudocount alpha
allocation_rules.ndvi_support_area: slots proportional to number of public grid cells inside the training-only top-5%-NDVI support mask

integer_allocation: largest remainder with deterministic island-name tie break

decision.question: After removing within-island environmental ranking, which training-only island-allocation signal adds stable recall over global maximum coverage?
decision.environment_survives_only_if: ndvi_support_area beats global max coverage and the best non-environment allocation with bootstrap lower95>0 and sign-flip p<0.05
decision.occurrence_allocation_survives_if: a training-occurrence allocation beats global max coverage with bootstrap lower95>0 and sign-flip p<0.05
decision.if_neither: Treat pure geographic/logistical coverage as the dominant transferable policy in this cohort.

hard_boundaries: Do not call these 16 taxa confirmation.
Do not consume the frozen 192 Practical Core cohort.
All allocation rules are frozen before held-out coordinates are inspected in each fold.
